title: Direct dependencies declared per project

metrics.name: deps.direct
metrics.label: зависимостей
metrics.means: Distinct DIRECT dependencies declared across the project's manifests, namespaced by ecosystem. Direct only, never the lockfile's transitive closure: what the operator decided is the direct set, and a change in it is a decision somebody made. `devDependencies` is excluded — a linter is not part of the project's surface area. A Gradle build that computes its dependencies in a loop is undercounted, which is why this says declared.

why: Track the declared direct dependency surface across project ecosystems. A count over time helps explain dependency growth and maintenance work without treating transitive lockfile entries as direct choices.
